implementationScope: Historical experiment using a larger runner. This repository is a smaller teaching extraction; no new paid model-driven application build of the extraction is claimed.

runtime.durationScope: Summed recorded phase durations, including retries and repairs; excludes gaps between phases and is not end-to-end elapsed time.

participation.scope: Accepted writes are participation evidence, not proof of net useful work.

validation.scope: Final game passed independent checks after host QA and harness repairs; legacy unfinished task records remained at the final checkpoint.

toolCallCounting.unit: Model-selected tool invocations, counted once from native_tool_call events across all 13 recorded phases. Agent/tool-call ID pairs were unique.
excludes: Harness heartbeat, observer and validation execution requests
Scripted protocol demonstration and publication tests
toolCallCounting.errorScope: Tool results marked isError; non-error refusals such as an unavailable lease or task may also represent no progress.
notes: Counts include refused, failed and repeated attempts; successful operations are not necessarily net useful work.
generate_image invocations differ from actual image-provider requests: budgets, validation and errors can reject attempts.
The smaller public teaching extraction supplies a different tool set and has not had a fresh paid model build.

limitations: Multiple phases, host QA feedback and harness repairs were necessary.
Models, prompts and infrastructure changed across phases; this is not a controlled performance comparison.
Tool calls are not one-to-one with serverless executions or image-provider requests.
Historical browser/image tools are outside the smaller reference tool set.
No private raw trace or original game is included.
